result.narrative:
Mehtab Agro Foods is carrying two open overdue notifications, one under each of its policies: INR 7,700,000 at 64 days past due on TCI-SCF-2026-0001 (logged 2026-09-20) and INR 3,000,000 at 41 days past due on TCI-WT-2026-0002 (logged 2026-10-13). The payment review records the trend as deteriorating: notification volume has risen from 1 to 2 over the last six months and now spans both policies, against a single prior overdue that resolved in 18 days. There is no matched news and no parent linkage.

The band is entirely payment-driven. Payment scores raw 98.0 at 64 DPD and carries 0.65 of the weight; news contributes 0.0 across the remaining 0.35, giving 0.65 x 98.0 + 0.35 x 0.0 = 63.7 and a PD of 0.5892. The adjudicator agreed with the High Risk band but attached caveats: the payment review reports INR 6.0M of overdue when the two notifications separately record INR 7.7M and INR 3.0M, it gives the oldest item an original due date of 2026-09-20 while that same dated notification already shows it at 64 DPD, and the scored 64 DPD predates the 2026-10-13 notification, so the input may be stale and the true aging worse. The adjudicator also notes the 0.0 news component reflects no matched articles rather than a verified clean record. Each discrepancy points toward equal or greater risk, so the band stands, but exposure and aging should be re-sourced from the notifications.

Both lines are recommended for reduction, cut to the limit where expected loss meets the 25% appetite against a PD of 0.5892. On TCI-SCF-2026-0001 (Meridia Bank, supply chain finance), the limit falls from INR 15,000,000 to INR 7,700,000, taking expected loss from 6,363,360 to 3,266,525. On TCI-WT-2026-0002 (Orvana Steel, whole turnover), the limit falls from INR 8,000,000 to INR 3,394,433, taking expected loss from 3,393,792 to 1,440,000. Maximum liability does not bind on either line, and the reductions are shown in full in the limit table.

The score would need to fall 13.7 points to drop below 50.0 and reach Watch, and because news contributes nothing, only the payment record can deliver that. Clearing or materially aging down the 64-day item on TCI-SCF-2026-0001, settling the INR 3,000,000 at 41 DPD on TCI-WT-2026-0002, and returning to the single-policy, 18-day resolution pattern seen historically are what would move this buyer down a band. Re-sourcing the overdue balance and the true current DPD from the notifications should be done before the limit letters go out, since the corrected figures may support a deeper cut rather than a shallower one.
